source_guardrail: Slote arXiv:2608.01424 refutes noncommutative quantum FEI, not classical FEI. This package analyzes one specific commutative replacement and sign-rounding procedure.

claims.statement: For any real flat orthogonal L-by-L matrix R, any unit vector W independent of uniform signs xi, and Boolean threshold sign(sum_j Y_j (R Diag(xi)W)_j), the data-averaged sum of control influences is at least (1/(2sqrt(6)))sqrt(L/ln(4L)). Independent parity controls of length r multiply the bound by r.
claims.dependencies: Elementary Rademacher moments, Hoeffding bound proved via cosh, Boolean unate influence identity
claims.scope: Only the specified actual Boolean threshold; uniform in all earlier layers

claims.statement: A norm-one linear form in independent signs is Boolean on every input iff its coefficient vector is one-hot. The final flat orthogonal/random-sign layer yields one-hot with conditional probability 2L/2^L if all |W_a|=1/sqrt(L), and zero otherwise.
claims.scope: Exact full-Booleanity assertion; norm-one or truncated cancellation alone is not substituted

claims.statement: The unrounded real function has supremum norm at least sqrt(L/3); any exact Boolean conditional-mean representation of lambda times this function has |lambda|<=sqrt(3/L).
claims.scope: Exact scalar conditional-mean model only; not a universal auxiliary-influence lower bound

claims.statement: For k Hadamard data layers and independent length-r parity controls, the unrounded real polynomial has flat Fourier support L^(k+1), entropy (k+1)log2L and Dirichlet energy r+k. Its Boolean sign rounding has control influence at least r/(2sqrt(6))*sqrt(L/ln(4L)). For L of order 3^r and r,k of order d this is exponential in d.
claims.not_proved: An entropy upper bound for all rounded functions, any obstruction to all possible classicalizations, or classical FEI

attribution: The earlier Booleanity-order report already contains a one-layer affine Hadamard threshold-cost mechanism; the present abstract final-layer formulation extends the bound uniformly to arbitrary preceding layers. Novelty outside the project is unverified.
verification_kind: Analytic proof with exact finite self-checks; no independent audit or formalization yet
